mathematical_definition: Among the trailing 60 fully-resolved historical start points t0, hist_barrier_hit_freq_60 is n_hits/(n_checked*sub_horizon) -- the 10bps-threshold hit count normalized by both the number of historical windows checked AND the sub_horizon length, giving a per-bar hit-rate distinct from hist_p_reach_10bps_10b_60's per-window probability (numba kernel first_passage_stats, window=60, sub_horizon=10, r_threshold_frac=0.001)
numerical_stability_notes: n_checked is always 60 once past warmup, so the n_checked==0 guard is defensive only and not expected to trigger in steady state; the extra /sub_horizon normalization is a constant (10) and introduces no additional instability beyond hist_p_reach_10bps_10b_60. Causality verified by direct code read during Phase 3 design (spec section 2): first_passage_stats's inner loop bound is t0 in [i-window-sub_horizon, i-sub_horizon) and j in (t0, t0+sub_horizon], so the maximum index ever read is j=i-1 -- every inner-loop index is strictly < i, no lookahead.
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first window+sub_horizon=70 bars, never zero-filled
